summary: Describes the Low Latency, Low Loss, and Scalable throughput (L4S) architecture. It rests on the idea that queuing delay is caused by capacity-seeking congestion controllers at senders, not by the queue itself, and it lets applications transition to scalable congestion control for very low delay. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Waiting lines grow because senders push until the line gets long. L4S has senders ease off a little early and often, so lines stay short.
